Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly identify and extract the full text of Audre Lorde's poem "Father Son and Holy Ghost" from the search results. Specifically, in Step 6, the agent accessed a Wikisource page that contained a hymn by Charles Wesley with the same title, mistaking it for Lorde's poem. This error highlights a failure to validate the content of the retrieved webpage against the specific author and task requirements, leading to the retrieval of irrelevant information instead of the necessary poem text.
